title: NAGICO Health Claim Form

coordinate_system.text_xy: x = left edge (or right edge when align is right, centre when align is center); y = text BASELINE
coordinate_system.checkbox_xy: cx, cy = centre of the printed box glyph; draw mark centred there
coordinate_system.image_xy: x, y = top-left of the box; w, h = size in pt

currency_note: The form has a dollar column and a cents column (the cent sign). Money is stored as integer cents; split at print time.

_do_not_fill_signatures_s2.note: Insured signature, patient signature and date (y 343 to 352) are signed by hand. Never stamp.

provider_block.note: Two lines: facility name and address on line 1, telephone on line 2. Shrink to fit down to 6 pt.

further_services.note: The box is divided into five ruled rows by the form grid. One line of text per row, never wrapped across a ruling.

further_services_dollars.note: ASSUMPTION: charge shown on the first row of the lower block. Confirm with NAGICO or the billing team.

surgical_dollars.note: ASSUMPTION: surgical charge shown on the Type of Operation row.

2.note: Sections 5 to 8 print unless their switch is set to "no"; section 9 (signature) prints only when sign_page2 is "yes".

sources_note: Every field has a 'source': a dotted path into the claim payload (e.g. lines.0.date). Checkboxes also have 'equals'. Money fields have 'part' (dollars or cents) and read an integer-cents value. 'generation_date' and 'total_amount' are computed by the renderer.
